title: Senstar Introduces the FiberPatrol FP1500 Precision-Locating Fiber Optic Sensor

body_markdown:
**Ottawa, CANADA–September 14, 2026 –** Senstar, a world leader in perimeter intrusion detection systems and video management solutions, announce


s the FiberPatrol® FP1500, a precision-locating fiber optic sensor for fence- and wall-mounted perimeter protection.


The FP1500 is aimed at sites where a perimeter breach carries high consequence, including data centers, correctional facilities, electrical utilities and substations, solar parks, and energy infrastructure. Because the sensing element is passive optical fiber, the sensor is immune to EMI and lightning and is unaffected by induced voltages near high-voltage equipment, and its field components are intrinsically safe in explosive atmospheres — allowing it to be installed where electrical or hazardous-area conditions constrain the choice of sensor.


The FP1500 uses coherent Rayleigh scattering to detect and locate intrusion attempts to within ±3 m (10 ft), including multiple simultaneous intrusions and in the presence of non-localized environmental noise that would overwhelm the locating capability of other long-range fiber optic sensors. Deployed in its cut-immune configuration, in which the unit’s two sensing fibers are run in opposite directions around the site, a single processor protects up to 5 km (3.1 mi) of perimeter and remains 100% operational after a cable cut — reporting the cut and its location while continuing to detect along the full perimeter.


The FP1500 pairs Senstar’s field-proven detection algorithms with a deep neural network that acts as a disturbance classifier, separating genuine intrusions such as climbing and cutting from environmental disturbances such as wind, rain, and hail. Combined with environmental disaggregation and compensation algorithms, this yields a typical probability of detection of 95% and a false alarm rate of less than one per kilometer per month, with alarms classified as fence climb, fence cut, ladder climb, or unknown.


“Customers increasingly evaluate perimeter systems on total cost of ownership rather than purchase price,” said Uri Guterman, Vice President, Product Management at Senstar. “The FP1500 needs no outdoor power, grounding, or communication infrastructure, so there is less to install and nothing in the field to service. Its deep neural network helps to eliminate nuisance alarms, maintaining operator trust in the system. And cybersecurity is built into the architecture rather than added afterward, so compliance does not become a separate project.”


With no powered or conductive components in the field, the FP1500 requires no outdoor power, grounding, or communication infrastructure, reducing both installation scope and the amount of equipment left exposed to weather and tampering. The sensor unit is a compact, IP66-rated, low-power device suitable for non-conditioned environments, mountable to a panel or rack-mount tray, and operating from –5 to +50 °C (23 to 122 °F).


The FP1500 is designed for seamless integration into existing security architectures. It integrates with VMS, SMS, and PSIM systems via a variety of interfaces, including Senstar Network Manager, MQTT, and ONVIF Profiles T and M. These options enable integrations with most systems, including Senstar’s own Senstar Symphony Common Operating Platform.


To avoid introducing new attack vendors to security networks, the FP1500’s secure-by-design architecture includes a dedicated hardware security module, secure boot, EAP-TLS network authentication, TLS 1.3 role-based access control, and tamper-resistant logging, making it compliance with IEC/ISA 62443, EN 303 645, and ready for the EU Regulation 2024/2847 (Cyber Resilience Act).


### About Senstar Corporation


With innovative perimeter intrusion detection systems (including fence sensors, buried sensors, and above ground sensors), intelligent video management, video analytics, and access control, Senstar offers a comprehensive suite of proven, integrated solutions that reduce complexity, improve performance and unify support. For over 40 years, Senstar has been safeguarding people, places and property for organizations around the world, with a special focus in utilities, logistics, corrections, and energy markets.
